name: 週末の寝坊が、平日の体調に影響する？(追加3記事)

p_3fc1ced79f.sentence: When you go to bed and get up much later, your body clock can move later, too.
p_3fc1ced79f.prev: But it does not know that Saturday is your day off.

p_db8f381cda.sentence: One blogger described this strange problem: “My worst Mondays came after my longest weekend sleeps, not my shortest.”
p_db8f381cda.prev: So why do you feel so tired?
p_db8f381cda.next: That is one person’s experience, not proof.

p_ea43c9209d.sentence: The goal is not to become a perfect morning person.
p_ea43c9209d.prev: Getting enough sleep during the week matters, too.
p_ea43c9209d.next: It is to stop asking Saturday and Sunday to repair five tired weekdays.

p_3be3b7e1d2.sentence: In one small study of 30 people, extra sleep after several short nights brought feelings of sleepiness back to normal.

p_d8e5f74e88.sentence: You open the curtains, eat breakfast, and enjoy a slow morning—not necessarily an early, busy one.
